DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域活動での言葉のお手伝いに、ご関心がおありですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in helping with languages at community activities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二つの言語で日常会話はできます。ただ、その言語の書類を何でも訳せると書くのは違うと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二言語の日常会話はできるが全書類翻訳可能とは申告しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can manage everyday conversation in two languages. But I thought it would be misleading to write that I can translate any document in those languages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you can converse in two languages but will not claim you can translate every document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような場面をお手伝いしたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kinds of situations would you like to help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会場の場所や持ち物を伝える場面です。専門の制度や医療の説明は、分かったふりで伝えたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会場と持物の案内を希望し専門説明は未理解で伝えないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Giving directions to the venue and explaining what to bring. I do not want to pretend I understand explanations of specialist systems or medical matters and pass them on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you would like to help with venue and packing information, and will not pass on specialist explanations you do not understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 活動の内容と、必要な支援の体制を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the activities and the support arrangements needed with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。全部任せられる人としてではなく、日常の案内を手伝いたいと希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全分野担当でなく日常案内の協力希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will say I want to help with everyday guidance, rather than present myself as someone who can handle everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to help with everyday guidance, rather than take responsibility for every field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない内容が出たときの相談方法も、担当とお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check with the person in charge how to seek advice when something you do not understand comes up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。聞かれたことをその場で推測して訳すのでなく、担当へ確認できる形で参加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明内容を推測せず担当へ確認できる体制を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would like to participate with a way to check with the person in charge, instead of guessing how to translate questions on the spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss arrangements for checking unfamiliar matters with the person in charge instead of guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加の日時や、ご本人のご都合も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also ask about activity dates and times and your availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休日の午後なら相談できます。今は応募の相談で、仕事の範囲が決まる前に引き受けたとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休日午後の都合を述べ仕事内容未決定なら承諾済とはしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can discuss afternoons on my days off. For now, I am discussing an application; I will not say I have accepted before the scope of the work is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your availability on afternoons off and explain that you have not accepted while the work remains undefined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: できる範囲も含めて担当へおつなぎします。それでは、活動のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will put you in touch with the person in charge, including information on what you can do. Please wait for the activity information. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご記入の「特になし」は、どの項目へのお答えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which question were you answering when you wrote “none in particular”?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きな病気をしたことがないという意味でした。でも、横の最近の状態の欄にも同じ丸を付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去の病歴なしの回答を最近の状態にも写したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I meant that I have never had a serious illness. But I also marked the same circle in the adjacent section about my recent condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you copied the answer about having no medical history into the section about your recent condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 過去のことと、最近気になっていることを分けて伺います。最近の変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask separately about the past and anything that has concerned you recently. Have there been any recent changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜、前より眠りにくいです。今まで大きな病気がないことを、最近も何も変化がないという意味にしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最近眠りにくく過去病歴と現在変化を区別したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have more trouble sleeping at night than before. I made having no serious illness in the past sound as though there had been no recent changes either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have had trouble sleeping recently and want to distinguish your past medical history from present changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 気になることは、担当へお伝えください。時期や様子は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person in charge about anything that concerns you. Do you know when it started and what it is like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週頃からです。毎晩かは記録していないので、全部の日と決めて書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先週頃からだが毎晩とする記録はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around last week. I have not kept a record of whether it happens every night, so I will not write that it happens every single day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it began around last week but you have no record establishing that it happens every night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入の訂正方法をご案内します。ほかにもまとめて答えた項目がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain how to correct the form. Are there other questions you answered together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の病気の欄もありました。自分のこととは別なので、覚えていることと知らないことを分けて答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族病歴も本人情報と分け既知と不明を区別したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was also a section about illnesses in my family. That is separate from my own history, so I would like to distinguish what I remember from what I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to separate your family's medical history from your own and distinguish known from unknown information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない項目は、その点を担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult the person in charge about questions you cannot answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一つの「なし」を全欄へ写さず、自分の過去、最近の睡眠、家族の情報をそれぞれ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一つのなしを全欄へ転記せず過去と睡眠と家族を個別確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Instead of copying one “none” into every section, I will check my past history, recent sleep, and family information separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check your history, sleep, and family information individually instead of copying “none” everywhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 項目ごとにお話を伺います。それでは、訂正した内容を診察でお伝えください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will ask about each question separately. Please explain the corrected information at your consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防犯のお話を聞く機会についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about an opportunity to hear a talk on crime prevention?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の集まりで、警察の方にお話をお願いできるか聞きたいです。来ていただけたら会社が安全と認められた、という意味にもなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社向け防犯講話を頼めるかと安全認定の意味があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to ask whether we can have a police officer speak at a company gathering. If they come, does that also mean the company has been recognized as safe?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a crime-prevention talk for your company can be requested and whether it means safety certification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 講話の依頼の相談と、会社の状態の評価は別です。どんな内容を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Discussing a request for a talk and assessing the company's condition are separate matters. What topics would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通勤中のトラブルや、困った時の相談方法です。会社の設備を検査してもらう依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通勤のトラブルと相談先が希望で施設検査ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Trouble during commuting and how to seek advice when something happens. I am not requesting an inspection of the company's facilities.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want commuting problems and advice contacts covered, rather than a facilities inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象者や日時のご希望をまとめ、担当へ可否や方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put together your intended audience and preferred dates and times, and check availability and procedures with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。日本語が難しい参加者もいるので、短い説明や資料について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象者と日程に加え簡潔な日本語説明や資料を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Some participants find Japanese difficult, so I would like to discuss brief explanations and materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss concise Japanese explanations and materials, as well as the audience and schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言葉のお手伝いをする方の予定も、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell the person in charge about plans for anyone helping with languages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同僚が日常の案内を補う予定ですが、警察の説明を勝手に言い換えて会社の規則にしないよう、役割を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚の言語補助の役割を確認し警察説明を社則へ変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: A colleague plans to supplement everyday guidance, but I will clarify their role so they do not freely rephrase police explanations into company rules.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will clarify your colleague's language-support role and avoid turning police explanations into company rules. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ実施のお約束ではありません。参加者への案内も、確認後になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is not yet a commitment to hold the event. Please inform participants only after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は希望の相談だけです。会社が安全と保証されたとは掲示せず、内容と日程が決まってから案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未実施の依頼相談で安全保証と掲示せず確定後に案内すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I am only discussing our wishes. I will not post that the company's safety has been guaranteed; I will announce it once the content and schedule are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that this is only an initial request discussion, and you will announce confirmed details without posting a safety guarantee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。それでは、依頼方法のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will convey your wishes to the person in charge. Please wait for information on how to request the talk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙の送り方と料金をご確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check how to send your letter and the postage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 便せんだけで考えて切手を用意しました。その後、写真を何枚か足したので、前と同じ料金でよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手準備後に写真を足し以前の料金が使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I prepared stamps thinking only of the writing paper. Then I added some photographs, so I want to ask whether the same postage still applies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the previous postage applies after adding photographs following your stamp preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の中身と封筒の状態で確認しましょう。写真はもう入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the current contents and envelope. Are the photographs already inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入っています。切手を買った時にはまだ決めていなかったので、その時の準備とは重さが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真封入済で切手購入時とは内容と重さが違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I had not decided on them when I bought the stamps, so the weight differs from what I had prepared then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the photos are enclosed and the contents and weight differ from when you bought the stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真が入った完成状態で、大きさや重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the dimensions and weight of the completed envelope with the photographs inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。便せんの枚数が変わらないから同じとはせず、写真と保護の紙も含めて見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便せん数だけでなく写真と保護紙を含め確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not assume it is the same just because the number of sheets is unchanged; please include the photographs and protective paper in the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a check including the photos and protective paper, rather than only the number of writing-paper sheets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: これから追加する物は、ほかにもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything else you plan to add?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の中身で全部です。測ってもらった後にもう一枚足すなら、また確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在が全内容で計量後に追加すれば再確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: These are all the contents. If I add another photograph after weighing, I will have it checked again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the current contents are complete and that adding anything after weighing requires another check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 料金が分かりましたら、用意した切手との扱いもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once we know the postage, we will also explain how to use the stamps you have prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。持っている切手に中身を合わせるため、写真を減らすと決めてはいません。まず完成状態で条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所持切手に合わせ写真を減らすと決めず完成状態の条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have not decided to remove photographs just to match the stamps I have. First I will ask about the requirements for the completed envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the requirements for the completed envelope without deciding to remove photos to match your stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 完成した封筒で確認します。それでは、こちらへお出しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the completed envelope. Please hand it over here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ATMのご利用で、ご相談があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about using the ATM, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号を一度間違えました。携帯を開く番号と、銀行のカードの暗証番号が同じだと思って入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯解除番号とカード暗証番号を混同し一度誤入力したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I entered the wrong number once. I thought my phone unlock code and my bank card PIN were the same, so I entered it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused your phone unlock code with your card PIN and entered it incorrectly once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号そのものは言わず、起きたことを教えてください。カードは戻っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what happened without saying the number itself. Has your card been returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードは手元です。違う番号かもしれないので、その後は思いついた数字を続けて入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード返却済で推測番号の連続入力はしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the card. Since it might be a different number, I have not kept entering numbers that came to mind afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have your card back and have not repeatedly entered guessed numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人とカードの状態を確認して、相談方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check your identity and the card's status and explain how to get assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。携帯の番号を書いて渡すこともせず、カードの暗証番号を混同したと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号を記して渡さず混同した事情だけ説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not write down and hand over my phone code either; I will just explain that I mixed it up with my card PIN.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the confusion without writing down or handing over any code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械には、どのような表示が出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: What message did the machine display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を確認する表示でした。写真は撮っていません。口座が止まったと判断したわけではなく、今の状態を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号確認表示は出たが口座停止と断定せず状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: A message asking me to check the number. I did not take a photo. I have not concluded that my account is blocked; I want to know its current status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there was a number-check message, but you want to check the status without concluding the account is blocked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が取扱いを確認します。ご本人確認に必要な案内もお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the procedure. Please also ask what is needed to verify your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。番号が分からないことと、カードや口座の状態を分けて相談します。自分で何度も試さず案内を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号不明と口座やカード状態を分け再試行せず案内を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will discuss not knowing the PIN separately from the status of the card and account. I will get guidance instead of trying repeatedly myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish the unknown PIN from the card and account status and seek guidance without retrying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認のご希望を担当へ伝えます。それでは、カードをお持ちのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your request for a check to the person in charge. Please wait with your card. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのシールは、どこにありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you find that sticker?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚の端に落ちていました。近くの商品へ貼れば、その値段で買えると思って手に取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落ちた値引シールを近い商品へ貼れると思い手にしたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It had fallen at the edge of a shelf. I picked it up thinking I could put it on a nearby product and buy it at that price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you picked up a fallen discount sticker thinking you could attach it to a nearby product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様が商品へ貼らず、こちらへお渡しください。何の商品に付いていたかは確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give it to us without putting it on a product yourself. Have you checked which product it was attached to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりません。近くにあるというだけで、この袋の物と決めていました。まだ貼ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未貼付で元の対象品は分からず近さだけで判断したと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know. I decided it belonged to this bag just because it was nearby. I have not attached it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you have not attached it, do not know its original product, and judged only by proximity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: シールの扱いは係が確認します。購入したい商品は、こちらの袋ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Our staff will check how to handle the sticker. Is this bag the item you want to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。シールはお渡しします。袋に元からある表示で価格を知ってから、買うか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: シールを渡し商品に元からある価格を確認後に購入判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will hand over the sticker. I would like to learn the price from the bag's original label before deciding whether to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over the sticker and decide on purchase after checking the product's original price label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この商品の価格を確認します。別の商品にもシールを移さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check this product's price. Please do not transfer the sticker to another product either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。安い物を探すため、シールに合いそうな商品を勝手に探して貼ることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: シールに合う別品を探し自己貼付しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not look for some other product that seems to match the sticker and attach it myself to find something cheap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not look for another matching item and attach the sticker yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お選びの商品については、会計前にご希望の価格を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the price you want to know for your selected item before checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。落ちていたシールの金額ではなく、この商品の今の販売価格を聞いて選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得シール額ではなく選んだ商品の販売価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will ask for this product's current selling price and choose based on that, rather than the amount on the fallen sticker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the selling price of your chosen item, rather than the amount on the sticker you found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: シールはお預かりしました。それでは、商品の価格を確認してご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have taken the sticker. We will check the product's price and let you know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 絵を描く場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。折り畳み椅子を持ってきました。芝生に脚が沈みそうなので、座る前に置ける場所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 芝生へ椅子脚が沈みそうなので座る前に置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought a folding chair. Its legs look likely to sink into the lawn, so I want to ask where I can put it before sitting down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to place your chair before sitting because its legs may sink into the lawn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で地面を固めたり、石を集めて脚の下へ置いたりせず、管理担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult the management staff instead of compacting the ground yourself or gathering stones to put under its legs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ座っていません。花壇の縁へ脚を乗せて平らにするのもやめ、椅子は畳んで持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未着座で花壇へ脚を乗せず畳んで持つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not sat down yet. I will not put the legs on the flowerbed edge to level the chair either; I am holding it folded up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not sat down and are holding the chair folded without resting its legs on the flowerbed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 描きたい対象は、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: What would you like to draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この木です。木に紙やひもを付けず、少し離れた所から描きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 描く木へ紙やひもを付けず離れて描きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This tree. I would like to draw it from a little distance without attaching paper or string to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to draw the tree from a distance without attaching paper or string. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周囲の通行や、ほかの利用者の場所も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also check nearby foot traffic and space for other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。写真を撮る人が来るので、荷物でその前を囲うつもりはありません。置くのは椅子一つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影者の前を荷物で囲わず椅子一つだけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. People come to take photos, so I do not intend to surround the area in front of them with my belongings. I will put down only one chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not block photographers with your belongings and will place only one chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる場所があるか担当へ確認します。難しい場合はどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge whether there is a suitable spot. What will you do if that is difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 椅子は使わず、短い立ち描きに変えます。道や地面を直してまで座る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 置けない場合地面を変えず立ち描きへ切替えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the chair unused and draw standing for a short time instead. There is no need to alter the path or ground just to sit down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that if you cannot place the chair, you will draw standing without altering the ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の場所を担当へ伝えます。それでは、椅子を畳んだままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge where you would like to sit. Please wait with the chair still folded. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ち合わせの方をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for someone you are meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駅にいる友達を探しています。列車の放送で名前を呼んでもらえば、すぐ来ると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人を列車放送で呼出せると思い相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am looking for a friend at the station. I thought they would come right away if their name were called over the train announcements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about calling your friend, explaining that you thought train announcements could be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 個人のお呼出しの取扱いは確認が必要です。運行の案内を、ご自身の連絡に使えるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the policy on personal announcements. You cannot necessarily use service announcements for your own communications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。列車の案内を変えてほしいという意味にはしません。友達の携帯へは連絡できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運行案内変更を求めず本人の携帯へ連絡可能と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Right. I am not asking you to change the train information. I can contact my friend's mobile phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are not requesting changes to service announcements and can contact your friend's phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず直接連絡して、現在地をお確かめになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you first contact them directly and check where they are?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話します。駅へ迎えに来る約束でしたが、友達がまだ到着していないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未到着の可能性もあるため直接電話すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call. They agreed to pick me up at the station, but they may not have arrived yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will call directly because they may not have arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お互いの到着状況が分かるまで、通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the passage clear while waiting until you know whether each of you has arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柱の横で待ちます。返事がないだけで、駅の中で迷っていると決めて探し回ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路脇で待ち無応答を駅内迷子と決めないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait beside a pillar. I will not assume they are lost inside the station and go searching just because they have not replied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait beside the passage and will not assume no reply means they are lost in the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅での案内が必要になった場合は、改めて状況をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need help at the station, please tell us the situation again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。直接連絡し、まだ来ていなければ到着を待ちます。運行放送の名前が私の友達の呼出しだとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の到着を確認して待ち運行放送を私用呼出しと捉えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will contact them directly and wait for their arrival if they are not here yet. I will not assume a name in a train-service announcement is a personal call for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check their arrival and wait, and will not interpret service announcements as private calls. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況が分かりましたらお声がけください。それでは、通行の妨げにならない場所でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know when you understand the situation. Please wait somewhere that does not obstruct others. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの資料は、ご自身で印刷されたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you print the documents you have yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。紙を減らしたくて小さく印刷しました。でも、裏の説明を印刷していないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 縮小印刷で元資料の裏面を印刷し忘れたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I printed them small to save paper. But I realized I had not printed the explanations on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you reduced the print size and forgot the back of the original document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の資料も、ご確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you also check the original documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家にあります。携帯にも全ページの写真がありますが、この印刷だけでは全部そろった資料とは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本と全ページ写真はあるが持参印刷だけでは未完と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are at home. I also have photos of every page on my phone, but this printout alone cannot be called a complete set.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the originals and photos of all pages, but the printouts you brought are incomplete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要なページと、読むことのできる大きさを担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with the person in charge which pages are needed and what size is readable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。小さい文字を読めるようにするだけでなく、抜けた裏面があることも先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字の大きさと裏面欠落を別々に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Besides making the small text readable, I will mention the missing back page first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check text size and the missing back page separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 印刷された数字や項目も、元の資料と照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare the printed numbers and items with the original documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。文字がつぶれて読めない所は推測で書き足しません。元の写真を見せて、どのページが必要か聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 潰れた数字を推測せず写真で必要ページを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not fill in illegible, blurred text by guessing. I will show the original photos and ask which pages are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which pages are needed using the photos, without guessing blurred numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不足がある場合の持参方法は、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to bring any missing material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。紙が少ないので全部確認済みとは言わず、元資料との違いを示してから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少ない紙で確認済とはせず原資料との差を示して相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not say everything has been checked because there are fewer sheets; I will show how it differs from the original before seeking advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show differences from the original and seek advice, without claiming fewer sheets mean everything is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不足したページのご相談としておつなぎします。それでは、元の写真をご用意ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will put you in touch about the missing pages. Please have the original photos ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自宅での記録に、確認したい点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something in your records at home you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体温計に数字と文字が出ました。その数字を体温として書きましたが、説明を見るとエラーの表示かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定器の数字を体温と書いたがエラー表示の可能性を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My thermometer displayed numbers and letters. I wrote the number down as my temperature, but after reading the instructions, I think it may have been an error message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you recorded a device number as your temperature but it may have been an error display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示されたものと、ご自身が記録した値を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish what was displayed from the value you recorded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真が表示です。今は測れた体温として確かではないので、正しい値だと言いたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示写真を示し確かな測定値とは言えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This photo shows the display. I am not sure it was a measured temperature, so I do not want to say it is a correct value.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the display photo and say you cannot call it a reliable measurement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ表示と記録を見せてください。機器の使い方が不明な場合も、確認してからにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the person in charge the display and your record. If you are unsure how to use the device, check that first too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。何度も同じ数字が出るから体温も同じだと決めず、値が分からないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 反復表示を同じ体温と判断せず測定値不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not assume my temperature is the same just because the same number appears repeatedly; I will say the measurement is unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the measured value is unknown rather than interpreting repeated displays as the same temperature. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の体の状態について、気になっていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything about your physical condition that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: だるさがあります。体温の数字が不明でも、その感覚までなかったことにしません。いつからかも話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数字不明でもだるさはあり開始時期も説明したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I feel sluggish. Even though the temperature number is unknown, I will not disregard that feeling. I will also say when it started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do feel sluggish despite the unknown number and want to explain when it began. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機器の表示と症状の説明は、それぞれ診療担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the clinician separately about the device display and your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真、誤って写した記録、だるさの経過を見せます。数字だけで自分の状態を判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と誤記と症状経過を別々に伝え数字だけで判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will show the photo, the record I copied incorrectly, and how the sluggishness has developed. I will not judge my condition by numbers alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the display, incorrect record, and symptom progression separately and not judge by numbers alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録の確認を担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、診察のご案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will hand over your request to check the record. Please wait for information about your consultation. Take care.
